name: Student Recreation Field
use: Large lighted synthetic-turf field for club sports, intramurals and summer camps

facts.text: Surface A-Turf Mono; 150,500 sq ft (430 by 350 ft), the largest of Campus Rec's fields; lit, open weekdays 6 am to 12:30 am.
Used for club sports, intramural leagues and summer camps; rental for UNH groups $201 ($262 with lights), non-UNH $275 ($375 with lights).

verdict: Campus Rec's largest lit turf field, used for club sports and intramurals.
notes: No licensed photo; Campus Rec image is a rugby action shot (not kept). Build year unknown. Location per notunh gazetteer: west of Bremner Field.
